item.description:
Changes since `v1.1.27`.
### Fixed
- **Commit+ AI and account services** — Commit+ AI, signing in to your account on the web, and deleting your account now connect to the new Commit+ servers in Singapore. Earlier versions can no longer reach these services, so update to keep using them.
[Compare v1.1.27 to v1.1.28](https://github.com/Commit-Plus/commit-plus/compare/v1.1.27...v1.1.28)
